note: Exception lexicon for scripts/lib/thai_g2p.py. Thai spelling is ambiguous in places no rule can settle - a consonant between two vowels can be the coda of one syllable or the onset of the next, and both readings are legal. The rule parser guesses; entries here override the guess. Keys are Thai surface forms WITH tone marks stripped, values are IPA syllables. This is a starting lexicon seeded from parser errors found in PHASE 7, not a pronunciation dictionary - add to it whenever build_timeline.py --report shows a word coming out wrong.
